title: A number held by two Part Library entries gets a new entry of its own
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Two Part Library entries have exactly the same part number, {Number-A} (for example a pair found on the Part Library list), with the same characters and upper and lower case, and the descriptions {Description-A} and {Description-B} (for example the two descriptions shown on those rows).
  • {Location-A} stocks no part whose number matches {Number-A}, ignoring upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces.
  • The description you will type is {Description-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL DUP OWN ENTRY).
  • Such pairs come only from before the release: this build links an exact number to its existing entry, so it cannot make a new pair.
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A}, go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type {Description-C} in Description.
  3. Type {Number-A} in Part Number, exactly as written down.
  4. Pick any Category (for example Uncategorized).
  5. Type a Cost (for example 10.00).
  6. Click Save.
  7. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Number-A} in the search.
  8. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Number-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the part is saved and the window closes. No message about the Part Library appears (no "Linked to … in the Part Library" message).
  • Step 7: three rows now show {Number-A}: the two old entries with {Description-A} and {Description-B}, unchanged, and a new one with Description {Description-C} (2 + 1 = 3).
  • Step 8: one row at {Location-A} shows {Number-A} with Description {Description-C}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S7-R8, S7-R10, Story 7 context note, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.4 (Saved and linked to the Part Library entry), board 7.1 (Part Library), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R8: “If more than one entry matches, the system creates a Part Library entry of its own for the new part.”
  • S7-R10: “No message about the Part Library is shown when the descriptions match, or when a new entry is created.”
  • PRD Story 7 context note: “A number that matches several entries exactly, or none, never gets guessed onto one of them.”
